title: String and fret on a note are rejected
description: The most basic fact of tablature — WHERE a note is played, string and fret — has no home on the MNX note. This document writes them as the flat note-level fields they would naturally be (the exact shape _x.mnxLab.string/fret drafts) and pins the rejection: the note object refuses unevaluated properties. The workaround is the vendor block; the fix proposed upstream is note-level position — see roadmap/proposed/spec-instrument-position.md.
